{{Top|leg}}
The '''Restuss Arts Jubilee''' was the oldest arts festival on the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Nabooian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies - Hefsen 1">{{GalaxiesAED}} - First mission from [[Hefsen Zindalai]]</ref> It took place in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Restuss]] before it was destroyed in the [[Battle of Restuss]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. The festival was organized by [[Hefsen Zindalai]].

==History==
In 1 ABY Zindalai finally convinced an artist of some renown he had been courting for years to attend the festival.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies - Hefsen 1" /> To guarantee the safety of the event, Zindalai asked [[Sloan Rusper|Lord Rusper]] to make sure that the area around the city was safe from attacks by dangerous animals.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies - Sloan">{{GalaxiesAED}} - Mentioned by [[Sloan Rusper]] in his first mission.</ref>

Several incidents nearly jeopardized the event in that year. People from Narmle hired a thief to steal a [[Hologram/Legends|holo]] that was used as the centerpiece of the Arts Jubilee. [[Draya Korbinari]] hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to track down the thief before the people of Restuss could learn about the theft. After he caught the thief, the spacer was asked to retrieve the holo from the smuggler who had bought it from the thief.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies - Draya">{{GalaxiesAED}} - First and second mission from [[Draya Korbinari]]</ref> Shortly before the event, a wealthy patron of the festival was attacked by bandits on his way to Restuss, but was saved by an escort sent by Zindalai.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies - Hefsen 3">{{GalaxiesAED}} - Third mission from [[Hefsen Zindalai]]</ref>

A similar event, the [[Narmle Arts Gala]], was organized by the city of Narmle, leading to some rivalry between the two cities.

==Behind the scenes==
The festival is part of several small quests from [[Wikipedia:non-player character|Non-Player Characters]] (NPC's) in [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] and [[Restuss]] (prior to its destruction in June [[2006]]) in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
